summary: Iteration 3 full-stack test of the Institution Setup Wizard + enforcement gates. Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3.py (20 new tests) covering setup-status, academic-config presets/idempotency, academic_units CRUD + coercion + tenant isolation, subject_offerings validation/dedupe, enrollment/teacher_assignment class-existence gates, classes->academic_unit_name, lookup/academic_units, and a full blank-slate setup->setup_complete->operationally_ready walk. Whole suite: 102/102 pytests pass. Frontend: verified setup gate (fresh admin forced to /app/setup, /app/dashboard blocked, /app/settings allowed), the 8-step rail with green checks, all inline CRUD steps (year, units incl. preset creation + add/delete, classes with required unit select, sections, subjects, teachers), Ready step badges + Go to Dashboard, Greenwood migration banner + Review setup link, fresh-tenant readiness banner, all 13 institution console pages load with no console errors, teacher & platform-admin logins unaffected and both correctly blocked from /app/setup (access-denied).

minor.issue: academic_unit_id is optional at API level; a class can be created with no academic unit (and academic_unit_name stays null) even though the new model says classes belong to a unit. Wizard enforces it client-side only.

'teachers' count reads the legacy `teachers` collection while setup-status/readiness counts users with role=teacher, so the dashboard shows Teachers 0 for an institution that has teacher logins (Greenwood and the fresh tenant both showed 0).

ui_bugs.issue: The teachers list renders ALL institution users (the institution admin row 'QA Wizard Admin / qa.wizard@qa.test' appeared) because GET /api/users is not filtered by role=teacher; its delete icon would delete non-teacher users from the wizard.
'Academic unit' field is not marked required in the console dialog (no * and Create succeeds without it), inconsistent with the wizard where it is required.

issues:
The note renders as three awkwardly stacked/wrapped fragments ('These models are' / 'configured & partially enforced' / 'today (used for readiness...)') because the inline inside the flex

breaks layout; should be a single wrapping paragraph.
The 'Not Operationally Ready (needs teacher + assignment)' pill is very long and low-contrast grey-on-grey compared with the adjacent Setup Complete pill; consider shortening + higher contrast.

action_items: Filter the wizard Teachers step list to role=teacher (add a role filter param to GET /api/users or filter client-side) so admins are not listed/deletable there.
Make academic_unit_id required for classes in the console form (and ideally validated server-side) to keep every class inside an academic unit.
Align institution stats 'Teachers' with users(role=teacher) or clarify the label, otherwise dashboard shows 0 teachers while a teacher login exists.
Fix the Academic Units MODEL_NOTE inline text wrapping.
critical_code_review_comments: InstitutionLayout.jsx: on a failed /institution/setup-status call it falls back to {setup_complete:true}, i.e. fails open and silently unlocks the console on a backend/network error — consider surfacing an error/retry instead.
InstitutionLayout re-fetches setup-status on every pathname change (one extra request per navigation); cache it in context or refresh only after mutations.

server.py startup() migration iterates all institutions on every boot; fine now but should be guarded/one-shot (it already writes migrated_general_unit=false for non-migrated tenants, which is OK) — note it also sets migrated_general_unit:false permanently, so a tenant that later gets classes without units will never be migrated again.

Setup enforcement is frontend-only for most modules: /api/res/* (e.g. students, subjects, assessments) can still be written before setup_complete; only enrollments/teacher_assignments have class-existence gates.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all flows worked; 2 UI/model inconsistencies + 2 design nits)

rca_of_the_issue: No blocking defects. Teachers-step contamination RCA: InlineList posts to /users with extra {role:'teacher'} but its GET /users list is unfiltered, so every institution user (including admins) is rendered with a delete action. Classes-unit RCA: enrich_institution_doc only resolves academic_unit_name when academic_unit_id is supplied and never requires it, so the console form (field not marked required) can create unit-less classes.
